## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: sites.fastspring.com: regression of #55938, mandatory "Terms of Service" checkbox hidden by generic `.gdpr-container` rule, checkout can't be completed

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date - [x] Browser version is up-to-date - [x] Disabling AdGuard protection (allowlisting the site) resolves the issue **Product:** AdGuard for Mac **AdGuard version:** 2.20 **Problem type:** Website or app doesn't work properly **Browser:** Firefox 158 (Desktop) **URL:** https://sites.fastspring.com/hopperapp/order/confirm **Enabled filters:** - Ad Blocking: AdGuard Base filter - Privacy: AdGuard Tracking Protection filter - Annoyances: AdGuard Annoyances filter (v2.2.83.64, filters updated right before reporting), AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances - Language-specific: AdGuard Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Spanish/Portuguese, Turkish, Ukrainian filters; AdBlockID; Dandelion Sprout's Nordic Filters; EasyList Czech and Slovak; EasyList Italy; Official Polish filters for AdBlock, uBlock Origin & AdGuard **Stealth Mode:** none (Stealth Mode disabled) ### Comment 1. On FastSpring's classic store order-confirmation page (reached after PayPal/card approval, before the charge), the legally required consent block "FastSpring Terms of Service and Privacy Policy / [ ] I agree with the terms of service and privacy policy" is hidden. Without ticking it, "Complete Order" cannot proceed, so the purchase cannot be completed. Allowlisting the site fixes it. The block is wrapped in: ```html
... I agree with the terms of service and privacy policy ... ``` It is matched by this generic rule in AdGuard Annoyances filter: ``` ##.gdpr-container:not(#style_important) ``` No other enabled rule matches any element around the checkbox. This is a regression of #55938 (see also #81519). The filter still contains the exception added for it: ``` sites.fastspring.com#@#.gdpr-container ``` But the generic rule is now `##.gdpr-container:not(#style_important)`. Element-hiding exceptions only cancel a rule with the identical selector, so the old exception no longer applies. Suggested fix (matching the current selector): ``` sites.fastspring.com#@#.gdpr-container:not(#style_important) ``` (FastSpring hosts checkouts for many vendors on sites.fastspring.com, so this likely affects many stores.) Note on reproduction: this page is only reachable after entering payment details, so screenshots and the DOM excerpt above were taken from a real checkout. Screenshot 2 was produced by injecting the exact rule's CSS into the same page. 2. Screenshots: two full-page screenshots (consent block visible with the site allowlisted, and missing with the rule applied.)

Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).
